source_en: ID and form, filled in the bread line. Noe Barbaqadze, corner grocery.
I open the shop every morning. Check the empty shelves. Stand a while. Close.
Habit. Routine feels more normal than the alternative.
Last truck came before the blast. I'm still selling its matches.
Quiet apartment. My neighbor [[whisper:stopped answering his door]]. I haven't knocked since.
If he answers, I have to see him. I'm fine.
No. Bread, then permits. I've stood in lines my whole life.
I thought about leaving once. The exit line was too long.
